description: Helena, MT — Mike Eisenhauer, a cardiologist and Army veteran from Great Falls, says he wants to represent Montanans in the middle as an independent candidate for the state’s eastern U.S. House seat. title: First, but possibly not last, independent candidate enters 2026 Montana elections - Eisenhauer for Congress
